top_concerns: No token/compute-matched controls: gains not isolated from extra pretraining compute, GPT-5 monologue distillation, or grounding data
No external baselines (other data-generation methods or contemporary 7B CUAs); absolute OSWorld-Verified SR (14-16%) is low
Headline 70% uses a single 50-step run vs 20-step baseline; test-time-scaling gain is within run-to-run variance
IDM claims overstated ('unsupervised', 'millisecond precision'); lenient any-overlap metric, 65.8% parameter accuracy, no end-to-end trajectory quality measure
No contamination analysis against OSWorld apps/tasks; multiple numerical and reference inconsistencies
